Opening
behaviour: Win+N or a click on the clock opens the center and the calendar together; Esc or a click outside closes them.

label: Do not disturb
behaviour: The bell button turns Do not disturb on and off; while on, the center says so and only priority notifications and alarms show a banner.

label: Clearing
behaviour: Clear all empties the center; a group's close button clears that app; a card's close button clears one card, and the cards below move up.

label: Expanding a card
behaviour: The time button expands a card to its full text and image and collapses it again; a group shows one card and a More notifications button that opens the rest and closes them again.

label: Calendar zoom
behaviour: The month and year header zooms out to the year and then the decade; picking a year or month zooms back in; Previous, Next and the wheel move a page.

label: Focus session
behaviour: The row under the calendar sets a focus length in 5 minute steps and starts a session, which turns on Do not disturb until it ends.

label: Banners in turn
behaviour: Banners show one at a time above the tray; the next waits until the shown one times out or is dismissed.

label: Dismissing a banner
behaviour: The close button or a swipe to the right sends a banner to the center; a click on it opens the sending app.

label: No make high priority
behaviour: This build's card menu holds only Turn off notifications for the app and Go to notification settings; priority is set in Settings.

label: Plain toast
behaviour: Title and body lines only; times out to the center.

label: Toast with buttons
behaviour: Up to five buttons in one row under the content; a button acts and dismisses.

label: Toast with a reply
behaviour: A text box with a send button; the reply goes to the app.

label: Toast with a selection
behaviour: A drop-down of choices above the buttons, read by the button pressed.

label: Toast with progress
behaviour: A progress bar with its title, status and value, updated in place.

label: Reminder or alarm
behaviour: Stays on screen until the user acts, with snooze and dismiss.

label: Incoming call
behaviour: A call layout with accept and decline that stays and rings until answered.

label: Urgent toast
behaviour: Breaks through Do not disturb, marked as important.
